methods.name: move
methods.doc: a step to the next tile; false if the way is blocked

methods.name: turn
methods.doc: turn on the spot to face this way, without leaving the tile

methods.name: getX
methods.doc: the robot's tile number along x

methods.name: getY
methods.doc: the robot's tile number along y

methods.name: getFacing
methods.doc: which way the robot is facing

methods.name: getNumber
methods.doc: the robot's number: 1 for the first, 2 for the second; of the one running this code

methods.name: canMove
methods.doc: whether the robot can step this way: there's a tile, it's free, and no customer or other robot is on it

methods.name: look
methods.doc: what stands on the next tile this way; null if nothing

methods.name: isFacing
methods.doc: whether this entity is right in front of the robot, on the tile it faces

methods.name: pick
methods.doc: take one item from the rack in front or, standing at the garage door, from the truck; false if that product isn't there or the hands are full

methods.name: getLoad
methods.doc: how many goods the robot is carrying now

methods.name: getCapacity
methods.doc: how many goods the robot can carry at once; raised in “Upgrades”

methods.name: has
methods.doc: whether the robot is holding this product

methods.name: getCarried
methods.doc: what the robot has in its hands now, one element per item, in the order it took them; an empty list if its hands are empty. It's a copy: changing it changes nothing in its hands

methods.name: getList
methods.doc: the robot's own list, its notebook: the same on every run and saved with the game; the robot's panel shows it, and its List button edits it

methods.name: isAtPickup
methods.doc: whether the robot stands on a pickup spot facing its rack; only then can it take from it or put on it (any next tile for a table, the front for shelves and fridges)

methods.name: getShelf
methods.doc: the rack (table, shelf, fridge) right in front of the robot; null if nothing holding goods is there

methods.name: putOnShelf
methods.doc: put a product from the hands onto the rack in front; false if it isn't in the hands or the rack is full. An error, which stops the program, if there's no rack in front or the rack is for another product

methods.name: isAtTruck
methods.doc: whether the robot stands at the garage door facing it, with the truck there and open; then robot.pick takes goods from it

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.doc: what's still in the truck, one element per item; an empty list if the robot isn't at the truck (robot.isAtTruck() checks that)

methods.name: isAtRegister
methods.doc: whether the robot stands behind the register at its screen, facing it; orders are taken there

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.doc: the customer waiting at the register whose screen the robot stands at; null if the robot isn't at a screen or nobody waits there. You can ask whether they're an adult: isAdult()

methods.name: takeOrder
methods.doc: take the order of the customer at this register; null if the robot isn't at the register's screen or nobody is waiting

methods.name: isAtBag
methods.doc: whether the robot stands behind the register at the bag, facing it; goods go into the bag there

methods.name: putInBag
methods.doc: put a product from the hands into the customer's bag; false if the robot isn't at the bag, isn't holding it, or the customer doesn't need it

methods.name: getWidth
methods.doc: the store's width in tiles: how many along x

methods.name: getHeight
methods.doc: the store's depth in tiles: how many along y, from the front wall to the back one

methods.name: isFree
methods.doc: whether tile (x, y) is free: it's in the store and nothing stands on it

methods.name: getEntity
methods.doc: what stands on tile (x, y); null if nothing. Outside the store it's null too, with no error, so keep x from 0 to getWidth() − 1 and y from 0 to getHeight() − 1

methods.name: getCashierCell
methods.doc: where to stand to take orders at the register on tile (x, y), its screen or its bag: the tile behind the screen, across from the customer. Face store.getRegisterSide(x, y) there. null if there's no register on (x, y) or something stands behind the screen

methods.name: getPackerCell
methods.doc: where to stand to put goods in the bag of the register on tile (x, y): the tile behind the bag. Face store.getRegisterSide(x, y) there. null if there's no register on (x, y) or something stands behind the bag

methods.name: getRegisterSide
methods.doc: which way to face behind the register on tile (x, y), the same at the screen and at the bag: toward the register, where the customer is. null if there's no register on (x, y)

methods.name: getRegisterNumber
methods.doc: the number of the register on tile (x, y), its screen or its bag: 1, 2, 3 or 4, as its panel shows. A register gets it when it's put up (the lowest free one) and keeps it wherever it's moved. 0 if there's no register on the tile

methods.name: getStock
methods.doc: how many goods are on what stands on tile (x, y); 0 if there are none, and if the tile is outside the store

methods.name: find
methods.doc: the first tile where this entity stands: rows in order of y, each row left to right; null if there's none

methods.name: findAll
methods.doc: every tile where this entity stands, in the same order; both tiles of a two-tile entity (a bread rack). A register's tiles differ: the screen is REGISTER, the bag BAG

methods.name: getPickupDirections
methods.doc: which ways to face on tile (x, y) to take this product: usually one, both for a tile between two of its racks. An empty list if it can't be taken from here

methods.name: getHour
methods.doc: the hour in the game: 0 to 23 (a day is 10 real minutes)

methods.name: getMinute
methods.doc: the minutes: 0 to 59

methods.name: getDay
methods.doc: which day it is: 1, 2, …

methods.name: getSeason
methods.doc: the season now: Season.SUMMER, AUTUMN, WINTER or SPRING, 10 days each. Seasonal goods can only be ordered in their season

methods.name: getWaitingCustomer
methods.doc: the customer at a register whose order nobody has taken yet, the one of them who'll leave first; null if nobody waits so. Wherever the robot is: customer.getPatience() tells whether it can get there in time

methods.name: getMoney
methods.doc: how much money the store has

methods.name: getBuyPrice
methods.doc: what ordering one item of a product costs: half its price, less with “Buy-in discount”

methods.name: getTruckCapacity
methods.doc: how many goods fit in the truck: no more can be ordered in one delivery

methods.name: callDelivery
methods.doc: call the delivery: the truck brings these goods, one item per element of the list; they're paid for at once. Seasonal goods out of their season won't come, and the order costs a $10 fine per such item. false if the truck is busy now, the list is empty or there isn't enough money; the note over the robot says why. More than fits in the truck is an error: such an order is split into parts

methods.name: getRemaining
methods.doc: how many of this product from the delivery called haven't been taken out of the truck yet, while it comes and while it stands at the garage; 0 once it's all unloaded or no delivery was called. Like the order's getRemaining, for the truck

methods.name: isTruckHere
methods.doc: whether the truck is at the garage. Just pulled up, it's still opening its door: robot.isAtTruck() tells whether goods can be taken yet

methods.name: isTruckAway
methods.doc: whether the truck is free: not driving and not at the garage; only then can it be called

methods.name: getGarageX
methods.doc: x of the garage tile right at the door: standing on it facing the door, the robot takes goods from the truck. If something stands on one of the two tiles at the door, the other one

methods.name: getGarageY
methods.doc: y of that same tile at the garage door

methods.name: getGarageSide
methods.doc: which way to face in the garage: toward the door

methods.name: sendTruckAway
methods.doc: send the truck off without unloading it all: the money for what's left in it comes back (an empty truck leaves by itself); false if there's no truck at the garage

methods.name: getProduct
methods.doc: which product lies on this rack; only it goes here

methods.name: getCount
methods.doc: how many goods are on the rack now. Only while the robot stands in front of it, or it's an error: stock is found out by going to look (from afar, store.getStock(x, y) with “Search”)

methods.name: getCapacity
methods.doc: how many goods the rack holds when it's full

methods.name: isFull
methods.doc: whether the rack is full: nothing more fits. Only while the robot stands in front of it

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.doc: whether the rack is empty: there's nothing to take. Only while the robot stands in front of it

methods.name: getX
methods.doc: the tile number along x

methods.name: getY
methods.doc: the tile number along y

methods.name: equals
methods.doc: whether it's the same tile: cell objects are compared with equals, not ==

methods.name: isAdult
methods.doc: whether the customer is an adult. Children can't be sold alcohol or cigarettes (18+ goods, product.isAdultsOnly()): cross them off the order with order.remove, or each one in the bag costs a $150 fine

methods.name: getPatience
methods.doc: how many seconds the customer will still wait at the register for the order to be taken (robot.takeOrder()) before leaving. Once it's taken the number stops going down: they'll wait. Too few left, and there's no getting to the register in time

methods.name: getProducts
methods.doc: which products are in the order, each once, in the order the customer named them

methods.name: getCount
methods.doc: how many of this product the customer wants; 0 if it isn't in the order

methods.name: getRemaining
methods.doc: how many of this product aren't in the bag yet

methods.name: getTotal
methods.doc: how many items the order has in all

methods.name: isDone
methods.doc: whether everything is in the bag; then the customer pays and leaves

methods.name: remove
methods.doc: cross this product off the order: every piece of it not in the bag yet (those already in stay and are paid for); the order's other products stay (removeRemaining() crosses off everything at once). false if there's nothing of it to cross off. When nothing is left to pack, the customer pays for the bag and leaves, or with an empty bag leaves with nothing

methods.name: removeRemaining
methods.doc: cross off everything not in the bag yet, every product at once (what's in it stays and is paid for). false if there's nothing to cross off. The customer then pays for the bag and leaves, or with an empty bag leaves with nothing

productMethods.name: isAlcohol
productMethods.doc: whether it's alcohol: such goods can't be sold from 22:00 to 6:00

productMethods.name: isAdultsOnly
productMethods.doc: whether the product is for adults only (18+), alcohol and cigarettes: it can't be sold to children (customer.isAdult())

productMethods.name: isPremium
productMethods.doc: whether it's a premium product (steak, truffles): expensive, but only a few customers take it (“Premium demand” in “Upgrades”)

productMethods.name: isVending
productMethods.doc: whether it's sold from a vending machine (chocolate, popcorn, coffee): nobody orders it at a register; customers walk to the machine themselves, and the robot only keeps it filled

productMethods.name: isInfinite
productMethods.doc: whether it never runs out (coffee): its machine is never empty and never needs filling

productMethods.name: isElite
productMethods.doc: whether it's an elite good (caviar, lobster): dearer and rarer still than premium (“Elite demand” in “Upgrades”)

productMethods.name: getPrice
productMethods.doc: the product's price; customers pay it × the revenue multiplier (“Revenue” in “Upgrades”, and decor); buying it in costs half

productMethods.name: getName
productMethods.doc: the name in the game's language, for example “Beer”

productMethods.name: getRack
productMethods.doc: the rack the product lies on

productMethods.name: getSeason
productMethods.doc: the product's season: it can only be ordered then; null for goods sold all year round

productMethods.name: isInSeason
productMethods.doc: whether it can be ordered now: it's sold all year round or it's in season. Out of season the delivery won't bring it, and the order costs a $10 fine per item

entityNotes.REGISTER: A register with a screen and a scanner. This is the screen's tile; the register's second tile, with the bag, is `Entity.BAG` in code.
